source_caption:
🎬 Boiler Room (2000)

Boiler Room follows Seth Davis, an ambitious young college dropout who dreams of becoming wealthy and earning the respect of his successful father. After running an illegal casino from his apartment, Seth is recruited by a mysterious brokerage firm promising enormous commissions, luxury lifestyles, and fast financial success. At first, the opportunity seems like the perfect path to riches, but he soon discovers that the company’s aggressive sales tactics and questionable investments hide a dangerous operation built on deception and fraud. As Seth becomes increasingly involved, he must choose between the money he has always wanted and doing what is right. Combining intense financial drama, powerful performances, and suspenseful storytelling, the film explores greed, ambition, corruption, and the consequences of chasing wealth at any cost.

🎭 Genre: Crime • Drama • Thriller

⭐ IMDb: 7.0/10

⏱️ Runtime: 2h • R

🎥 Director: Ben Younger

🏆 Recognition: Starring Giovanni Ribisi, Vin Diesel, Ben Affleck, Nia Long, and Nicky Katt, the film became a cult favorite for its realistic portrayal of high-pressure stockbroking, aggressive sales culture, and financial manipulation.

source_details.synopsis: Boiler Room is a 2000 American crime drama film written and directed by Ben Younger and starring Giovanni Ribisi, Vin Diesel, Nia Long, Ben Affleck, Nicky Katt, Scott Caan, Tom Everett Scott, Ron Rifkin and Jamie Kennedy. The film was conceived when Younger interviewed for a job at brokerage firm Sterling Foster. "I walked in and immediately realized, 'This is my movie.' I mean, you see these kids and know something is going on." Boiler Room premiered at the Sundance Film Festival on January 28, 2000, before being released by New Line Cinema on February 18, 2000.
